annotation.interpretation_a: Any frame not explicitly defined as a HEADERS frame is considered an error.
annotation.interpretation_b: Any frame that is not a continuation of the current HEADERS frame sequence is considered an error. This could include RST_STREAM, PUSH_PROMISE, etc.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'any other type of frame' is insufficiently constrained. It's unclear whether it refers to any frame that isn't a HEADERS frame at all, or any frame that isn't a continuation of the current HEADERS frame sequence. This impacts how a receiver handles different frame types following a HEADERS frame.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'other type of frame' is not precise. Does it include continuation frames for the HEADERS frame, or only entirely different frame types?
